ruleDefinitions.name: Uncommon Child Process Of Conhost.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects uncommon "conhost" child processes. This could be a sign of "conhost" usage as a LOLBIN or potential process injection activity. Note: Unmapped fields: Provider_Name

sequences.query: parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\conhost\\\.exe$") AND  NOT (process_path = RGX("\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\conhost\\\.exe$") OR process_path = "None" OR process_path = "") AND  NOT (Provider_Name = "SystemTraceProvider\-Process")
